name: Barcelona Province (Spain)

colors.symbolism: the field of the bars of Aragon

description: The bars of Aragon (a gold field with four red pals) charged at the centre with a white lozenge bearing the red Cross of Saint George.
history: The flag of the province of Barcelona displays the provincial coat of arms on a solid field.
